factor_basis.initial_alpha: checked-in default and checked-in minimum, not selected by WCT outcome
factor_basis.control_window: one third of default, registered default, and twice default
factor_basis.steady_cohort: fixed final 90 seconds after exactly three default 30-second warmup opportunities; backlog is retained

required_outputs: warmup-inclusive and fixed steady-arrival-cohort healthy WCT decomposition
fixed 30-second bin integrals of active requests, waiting requests, serving GiB, Peer-HBM backup GiB, and headroom GiB
all controller steps with alpha, pressure, release and dispatch
paired seed differences against the single Native reference
evidence_boundary: Healthy-path cold-start sensitivity in the preliminary metadata DES. It is not physical evidence; initial alpha and control windows are configuration sensitivity factors, not measured optimal settings.
